rq2.main_descriptive_score: excess same-group edge share over finite-roster chance
rq2.contrasts: all six unordered method pairs; second minus first on shared model/setting/seed support
rq2.aggregation: mean paired seeds within each model/setting; equal weight of 28 cells; missing cells suppress overall mean
rq2.ranks: shared defined seeds across attributes; cross-score sensitivity additionally uses shared support across all scores
rq2.omission: omit each of eight seeds globally; descriptive sensitivity, not confidence intervals
rq2.rewiring: not added: inherited diagnostic does not establish labeled-degree convergence

external.sampling: uniform 50-node induced draws with historical nested 25/40 thinning; isolates retained

external.screening: documented friendship; >=50 observed nodes; expected edges at n=50 >=1; exact published 800 endpoints and 6429 raw edge records
external.pre_comparison_cleaning_amendment: Raw inventory check found 11 self-links and zero duplicate undirected pairs before comparison outcomes were computed. Remove only those self-links, retain all 800 endpoints; analyze 6418 simple edges and zero observed isolates. Raw files remain unchanged.
external.old_baselines: reuse sealed 8 banks x56 graphs each; ER p=.18893569470401766, BA m=5, WS k=10 p=.2; no refit
external.new_transfer_baselines: none: preserve historical transfer comparison and avoid target-driven extra tuning
external.target_density_ER: 8 banks x56 G(n,p) graphs at Copenhagen full-record density; explicitly target-informed diagnostic, not transfer competitor
external.weighting: equal seven instruction weights within each method/model; average four model distances, not pooled W1; equal eight baseline-bank distances
external.sampling_ranges: finite-record min/max, NOT confidence intervals or independent-community replication
